results.name: Schema 12 persists the canonical Gameplay Core and older inputs default it disabled
The public starter set is exactly the five approved templates and recipes create ordinary canonical records
Actor Definitions stay reusable while Actor Instance overrides and transient state remain isolated
Runtime Actor slot reuse rejects stale handles through generation-tagged identity
Room persistence survives reconstruction while Runtime Actor state resets
World variables communicate across authored Rooms without serializing Runtime Actors
Missing and cross-owner Room/World references are rejected atomically
Unknown conditions/actions survive authoring and executable builds reject them without stale output
Every canonical operation has a typed operand schema and malformed operands reject before code emission
Known canonical actions never compile as no-ops in the generated NROM profile
The generated profile explicitly executes or rejects every canonical condition and action type
Generated persistent RAM accepts the exact 64-byte profile capacity and rejects max plus one
Transition evaluation is deterministic by priority and then authored order
Single-room generated runtime links actor graphics, executes actors and preserves Room state across restart
World generated runtime links actor graphics and executes the same canonical patrol/pickup semantics
Canonical transition semantics and authored ordering match across single-room and World plans
Sideview Player template is an explicit retained-runtime binding and preserves legacy movement
Ground Patrol template executes movement and contact damage against the compatibility player
Stationary Contact Hazard template obeys its authored persistent enable flag
Collectible and Switch + Door templates retain their declared Room state across reconstruction
Typed table UI can author every core record family without project JSON editing
Room placement and Room persistence are authored through UI and survive World leave/re-entry while transient state resets
Reachable destination-World actors are linked, instantiated and executed while unreachable actors remain diagnosed authoring data
The 12-actor executable limit counts the Sideview compatibility Player and rejects overflow without omission
Canonical component schemas validate effective values and reject malformed known fields before emission
Behavior actions and Actor Instance bindings remain authoritative over legacy component mirrors
Disabled Behavior is inert in emitted single-room and World runtimes and re-enabling restores execution
Generated overlap uses boundary-safe unsigned distance on both axes in single-room ROM execution
World emitted overlap uses the same unsigned boundary contract and current-screen isolation
Single-room Gameplay Core ROM reopening reports partial restoration and preserves original bytes
syncActiveFromPersistent remains explicitly one-way until reconstruction and is not a physical Door contract
All five legacy whole-ROM oracles remain byte-identical when Gameplay Core is unused
